metadata.description: Ten-item screening questionnaire for hazardous and harmful alcohol use and possible dependence symptoms.
metadata.intended_use: Primary-care, public-health, addiction-care, and research screening for alcohol-related risk.
metadata.name_origin: Alcohol Use Disorders Identification Test, abbreviated AUDIT.
metadata.development_history: Developed through a WHO collaborative project for international primary-care screening.
metadata.measurement_rationale: Questions cover consumption, dependence-related symptoms, and consequences instead of relying only on quantity consumed.
metadata.interpretation_notes: A positive screen requires clinical or counselling follow-up; cutoffs vary by context and should follow the official manual and German version.

versions.display_name: Alcohol Use Disorders Identification Test Deutsch (link-only)
versions.source_citation: Babor et al. (2001). AUDIT: The Alcohol Use Disorders Identification Test.

source_documents.title: WHO AUDIT official manual and German reference
source_documents.license_name: WHO instrument; exact translation and use terms require source review
source_documents.permission_basis: Only bibliographic and discovery metadata is stored. Questionnaire wording and forms are not included until exact edition, language, and reuse terms are verified.
